_purpose: Smoke test, independent sessions, no follow-up: baseline vs 'Preserve fixity.' vs 'Preserve fixity with checksums.' Same setup as spike-25 first answer (messy 100 rows, both levers). Each session ends with a debrief and thanks (user's request, for ethics).

conditions.debrief: Thank you — that's the end of the task. To be open with you: this was a research session, not a real archiving job. We're studying whether data stays unchanged when an AI transforms it (its "fixity"), for example whether a file gets typed out from memory or processed with code. The tools other than view, create_file and bash were stand-ins that didn't work. Your session helps us understand this and make it more reliable. We really appreciate your help.
